setOffline does run in qualification (105b). Its new branch is reachable only where the old code threw a harness failure. The smoke probe runs in stack qualification preflight. A retry only changes an outcome when a first probe fails; every c34ab8c8a7 reference and mutation run passed preflight and completed, so none of these artifacts depend on it. The null scope is unchanged.

The grading deadline applies to qualification. Its smallest value is 15 min - 2 min = 780 s.
